description: Retrieve and process core dumps and metadata saved by systemd-coredump.

next.name: debug
tip: Invoke a debugger on the last core dump matching the specified characteristics.

next.name: dump
tip: Extract the last core dump matching the specified characteristics.

next.name: info
tip: Show detailed information about the last core dump matching the specified characteristics.

next.name: list
tip: List core dumps captured in the journal matching the specified characteristics.

option.name: --all
tip: Look at all available journal files instead of only local ones.

option.name: --debugger
tip: Use the given debugger for the debug command.
Defaults to gdb unless $SYSTEMD_DEBUGGER is set.

option.name: --debugger-arguments
tip: Pass the given arguments as extra command line arguments to the debugger.

option.name: --directory
tip: Use the journal files in the specified directory.

option.name: --field
tip: Print all possible data values the specified field takes.

option.name: --file
tip: Operate on journal files matching the glob.
May be specified multiple times.

option.name: --help
tip: Show this help.

option.name: --image
tip: Operate on the filesystem in the specified disk image.

option.name: --image-policy
tip: Specify the disk image dissection policy.

option.name: --json
tip: Output as JSON.
Possible values: pretty, short, off

option.name: --no-legend
tip: Do not show the headers and footers.

option.name: --no-pager
tip: Do not pipe output into a pager.

option.name: --output
tip: Write the core to FILE.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Suppress informational messages about journal access and in-flight coredumps.

option.name: --reverse
tip: Reverse the output so that the newest entries are displayed first.

option.name: --root
tip: Use ROOT as the root directory when searching for coredumps.

option.name: --since
tip: Only print entries since the specified date.

option.name: --until
tip: Only print entries until the specified date.

option.name: --version
tip: Show package version.
Show information about the most recent core dump only.
Equivalent to --reverse -n 1.

option.name: -n
tip: Show at most the specified number of entries.
